build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template where a ball must pass through holes in bars to reach the bottom wall
create_bar_with_hole: create two static bars with a configurable gap between them using the _bar_with_hole helper function
define_task_template_decorator: define a parameterized task template using the define_task_template decorator with ball_size, hole_size, hole_left, and bar_height parameters
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid task parameter combinations by raising SkipTemplateParams when the ball is larger than the hole or misaligned
update_task_goal: update the task goal using C.update_task to require the ball touching the bottom wall via SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
